mission: Turn 100 grand challenges into a pipeline of independently checkable progress: exact verifiers, certified finite cases, audited claims and restricted lemmas, with no breakthrough declared by announcement.
interpretation: Planning document. A shipped item is infrastructure, a reproduction of known mathematics or an audit unless its evidence says otherwise. Nothing here changes data/solved.json.

horizons.shipped: Merged on main with evidence in the repository.
horizons.now: Being worked on; top of the execution queue.
horizons.next: Scoped and ready to start once a current item finishes.
horizons.later: Committed direction; scope still to be set.

tracks.name: Registry & ranking
tracks.goal: One canonical, scored, provenance-tracked list of exactly 100 targets.

tracks.name: Research engine
tracks.goal: Evidence-aware readiness, campaigns and a strict promotion gate to Solved.

tracks.name: Exact probe lab
tracks.goal: Every computable problem gets a search plus an independent checker on a reusable engine.

tracks.name: Proof campaigns
tracks.goal: Push the highest-ranked targets toward reviewed restricted results.

tracks.name: Claim audit
tracks.goal: Check announced resolutions for exact scope before spending effort on them.

tracks.name: Trust & reproducibility
tracks.goal: Pinned artifacts, proof certificates and CI that reruns everything.

tracks.name: Site & community
tracks.goal: A public dashboard and a contribution path that keeps the bar high.

items.title: Registry of 100 scored problems
items.outcome: Stable IDs, working questions, first attacks, weighted scores (30/30/25/15) and provenance.

items.title: Deterministic ranking with drift check
items.outcome: Generated rank order that CI rejects if stale.

items.title: Research protocol and source policy
items.outcome: Rules for advancing, scoring and retiring candidates; official Clay citations.

items.title: Milestones, readiness and strict Solved gate
items.outcome: Readiness bonus (0-10) kept separate from editorial score; promotion gate tested.

items.title: Execution-priority queue
items.outcome: Evidence-aware ordering of all 100 with a next step per problem.

items.title: Proof campaigns with bounded first attacks
items.outcome: Precise statements, verifiers and proof obligations.

items.title: Caccetta-Häggkvist census and SAT target
items.outcome: Symmetry-certified 5-vertex census, two independent SAT encodings with semantic tests, n=18 r=6 target.

items.title: Frankl and Ramsey small-case benchmarks
items.outcome: Exhaustive union-closed check and small Ramsey certificates; known cases only.

items.title: Exact probe lab: 15 probes on 11 engines
items.outcome: Search plus independent checker at smoke and deep levels; verifier coverage 3 -> 17.

items.title: Computational modality for every problem
items.outcome: Each problem tagged; engine roadmap lists every computable problem without a probe.

items.title: Scope triage of all 15 claimed 2026 resolutions
items.outcome: Primary sources, quantifier comparison and next checks; M098 de-scoped; no status upgraded.

items.title: Pinned external proof corpus with hash verifier
items.outcome: Streaming SHA-256 check with negative tests.

items.title: CI and weekly deep reruns
items.outcome: Every generated file drift-checked on each PR; weekly deep probe and M074 reruns.

items.title: Public research dashboard
items.outcome: Ranked search, campaigns, lab, proof queue, Solved ledger and this roadmap, all from verified records.

items.title: Contribution workflow and evidence templates
items.outcome: Issue and PR templates that demand exact scope and reproducible evidence.

items.title: Leverage dispatch across shared attack shapes
items.outcome: Every problem has one action and one shared shape. Dispatch score, not readiness alone, orders the attack queue. A range extension inside a cited theorem is refused.

items.title: 100-slot proof-exchange wave across the portfolio
items.outcome: Every campaign has a proof-obligation node; scale.py packs 100 claimable slots with scout/adversary/checker roles, refuses stop_range, and regenerates SCALE.md under CI drift checks. Operating capacity, not a theorem multiplier.

items.title: Separate first-order Vaught from the 2026 infinitary counterexample
items.outcome: M098 is verified_open on the Pillay-Tanovic survey plus the authors' own exclusion. The infinitary manuscript cannot promote it to resolved.

items.title: Certified structure mines on five campaigns
items.outcome: Deck invariants, poset balances, Goldbach record primes, Erdos-Straus residue patterns and Frankl orbits, each recomputed by a second code path.

items.title: Erdos-Straus parametric identities from the residue mine
items.outcome: Nine polynomial identities, including n=120t+73 and n=120t+97, cover 106 of 117 hard-class primes through 8,000; remaining misses lie in {1,49} mod 120.

items.title: Independent replay of the external r=6 corpus
items.outcome: Replay on a second host, verify hash and proof traces, audit hand reductions before duplicate SAT search.
items.exit: Replay log and audit notes committed; discrepancies filed as issues.

items.title: SIC fiducials in d = 4..8
items.outcome: Extend the cyclotomic engine to the needed number fields and replay published exact fiducials.
items.exit: Deep probe passes for d <= 8 with an independent overlap checker.

items.title: Frankl minimal-counterexample lemma
items.outcome: Canonical families under ground-set permutations; prove or refute a restricted lemma.
items.exit: Written lemma with a finite certificate, submitted for independent review.

items.title: Census mining for reconstruction and 1/3-2/3
items.outcome: Deck and balance tables are certified in MINES.md. The remaining work is a lemma for width at least 3, and a deck invariant stronger than degree plus triangles.
items.exit: Published tables and a named family with a conjectured lemma.

items.title: Arcs in PG(3,q) and Hadamard orders 116, 156, 172
items.outcome: 5-point frames for q <= 9; multiplier symmetry for Williamson n=29; Goethals-Seidel arrays.
items.exit: All Hadamard orders 4k <= 172 constructed except literature-open ones.

items.title: Interval-arithmetic zero counts for zeta and L(s, chi_4)
items.outcome: Rigorous N(T) for zeta up to height 36 and for L(s, chi_4) up to height 17, each matched to Hardy sign changes and replayed at a second truncation.

items.title: Group-character engine
items.outcome: Exact conjugacy, radical p-subgroups and character-degree counts; Alperin weight probe matches p-regular classes on named groups through A5.

items.title: M071/M073 witness extractability audit
items.outcome: Pinned Sidorenko faces table independently reconstructed (35 vertices, 66 edges); Hadwiger claim recorded as existential with no finite adjacency list; frozen CI ledger and precise gaps.

items.title: Computational checks of claimed group-ring witnesses
items.outcome: Independent group-ring checker for the shared M044/M049 direct-finiteness construction; separate nonsoficity audit for M049.
items.exit: Each witness reproduced or a precise gap reported.

items.title: DRAT/LRAT proofs from SAT pipelines
items.outcome: Every UNSAT verdict ships a proof checked by an independent checker.
items.exit: CI checks proofs for the M074 and M096 encodings.

items.title: Replay published certificates the lab does not yet check
items.outcome: Import the published K42 colouring and one published small-format tensor decomposition, each replayed by the existing checker. Do not extend a range the dispatcher marks stop_range.
items.exit: Both certificates replayed, or a precise gap reported for each.

items.title: Restricted lemmas for the zero-readiness tier
items.outcome: Falsifiable restricted statements and prior-art audits for sunflowers, Dixmier, Erdős-Hajnal, Komlós and complexity targets.
items.exit: Five new campaign briefs, each with a falsifier.

items.title: Status audit of the 95 non-Millennium entries
items.outcome: Dated specialist sources for each; replace resolved or duplicate candidates without exceeding 100.

items.title: Formal statement fidelity
items.outcome: Lean encodings where the statement can be checked against the registered conjecture.

items.title: First independently reviewed new restricted result
items.outcome: Earn the +3 readiness bonus that no problem has yet.

items.title: Outside contributor pipeline
items.outcome: Certificate issue templates, a reproducibility bot and published compute budgets per probe.
